neighbours.label: The lowercase word ' of' in any role: noun of noun ('cup of coffee'), after adjectives and verbs ('afraid of', 'thinking of'), after is/was ('is of great importance'), even last in a sentence. Capitalised 'Of' (sentence start, titles) fires only about half as much, and ' to' fires weakly (~0.4). Other prepositions (in, on, for, from, at, by, with) and look-alikes off, offer, officer, often, o'clock stay quiet.
neighbours.short: the word ' of' (any role); 'Of' and ' to' weaker
fire: She ordered a cup of coffee before the meeting.
My little brother is afraid of the dark.
I was thinking of you when I saw the old photo.
This decision is of great importance for the whole village.
Most of the guests left early.
The capital of Peru is Lima.
He grabbed a handful of almonds from the jar.
That is exactly what I was afraid of.
quiet: She ordered a black coffee before the meeting.
My little brother is scared in the dark.
I was thinking about you when I saw the old photo.
This decision matters greatly for the whole village.
He grabbed some almonds from the jar.
That is exactly what I was worried about.

predictions: 8/8 fire above 0.5, near misses under 0.3 (blind-authored test)
